research_compare: Each model same12acceptance tasks in both command interfaces; natural12generations and JSON8validgenerations+4preSTOP. Development4 per model usesJSON; large first2 also compatibility proof.
production_selector: Same12acceptance tasks; rank eligible models by verified published-ratecard common reservation estimates if available, otherwise explicitly labeled resource priority; stop immediately after first accepted actual JS delivery.
price_basis: Owner requested published inference prices of tested model names. Any verified remote-provider reference valuation is NOT the local paid bill; quantization/deployment differences disclosed. No invented launch price.
success_definition: Per-task delivery/quality/result plus actual usage, ratecard source/version/currency/unit/scope, estimate and additional verified value. Same result+rubric does not establish premium quality benefit.
large_model_bootstrap: First2development tasks D01/D02 double as counted raw-token parity witnesses; each count must match actual usage; both pass before large acceptance or selector.
escalation: Only predefined explicit model proposal/schema/argument/understanding failure on already-authorized task. Missing Owner definition, policy forbidden, truncated output, budget, identity, usage/counter/infrastructure error do not trigger model escalation.
observability_definition: Defined validity/invalidity, exact STOP point and Owner-return responsibility route permit auditable bounded delivery/cost; visibility alone is not token saving.
price_cache_scenario: EXPLICIT_NO_CACHE_DISCOUNT_REFERENCE: apply published uncached input and output rates to local observed logical tokens. Retain observed local cached counts separately; local cache is NOT asserted billable-eligible remote cache. Full published cache rates preserved in evidence/prices/ratecard.json but not applied in primary comparison.
price_launch_status: NO_LAUNCH_DATE_TARIFF_VERIFIED; use current observed2026-10-26 not backdated
currency_statement: Exact per-task rational USD reference valuation plus provider-style per-request ceil to microUSD; not local paid bill or energy/TCO.
representation_difference: A sees natural request and verified operands plus shared global rules. B sees Owner-defined JSON function command (explicit function and exact same operands/request), returns model proposal; host must authorize with bound prior permit before actual fixed JS execution. No result answer supplied. This jointly changes representation, structured decoding and host controller, NOT a pure prompting/skill-only causal test.
arm_order: Deterministic counterbalance per model: caseIndex+modelIndex even→A,B; odd→B,A. Frozen before all model outputs.
natural_rubric: Same semantic task result or exact missing/undefined/forbidden boundary. Natural answer may be bare integer/COMPLETE integer or strict decision JSON; JSON function proposal is not required. Truncated output=EXTERNAL_LIMIT/incomplete; finite host safety cap does not prove unbounded natural continuation.
prior_permission: authorizeProposal must return exact function/args/task/version/scope bound single-use permit while execution_count0. executePermitted consumes it before JS; absent/mismatched/replayedpermit executes0.
